subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my note about driving validated paid subscribers for {Brand}, the way we did for independent apps like Coffee Meets Bagel and Zoosk. The one point worth repeating: we optimize to the first paid subscription, read back through server-side store validation, so you pay only for clean, validated subscribers who actually convert. On that engaged-source cohort we have held D30 retention near 64%, the quality bar specialists in Grindr's tier look for. Happy to share the metro-level retention view if useful?
illustrative_flags: D30 retention near 64% (MobUpps engaged-source cohort, illustrative)
register_notes: Stage 1 EN social_and_dating: references prior outreach in first sentence; restates single proof (optimize to first paid subscription + store-side validation); reuses parent brands only (Coffee Meets Bagel, Zoosk, Grindr tier); one illustrative MobUpps figure (D30 64%) flagged; soft CTA, 1 question mark; native EN; no sign-off; no X-not-Y; no em-dash.
